title: RECOVAR: Representation Covariances on Deep Latent Spaces for Seismic Event Detection
abstract: arXiv:2407.18402v3 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Modern deep learning methods have improved earthquake detection, but the most widely used approaches typically rely on supervised learning from large labeled waveform datasets. Constructing such datasets is time-consuming and introduces biases from existing catalogs, detection pipelines, and human review, which can limit cross-dataset generalization and sensitivity to underrepresented events. We present RECOVAR, an unsupervised method for seismic event detection that can be trained directly from raw waveforms without using event/noise labels. The method uses an ensemble of convolutional autoencoders and detects events by measuring temporal alignment in their compressed latent representations through a cross-covariance-based metric. The results suggest that RECOVAR can reach the performance of supervised detectors on public benchmark datasets, remain robust under cross-dataset scenarios, and stay effective on imbalanced continuous wav

translated_title: RECOVAR：基于深度潜在空间表示协方差的地震事件检测方法
translated_abstract: 现代深度学习方法提升了地震检测的效果，但目前应用最广泛的方法通常依赖于从大量带标注的波形数据集中进行监督学习。构建此类数据集既耗时，又会引入来自现有地震目录、检测流程和人工审核的偏差，这可能限制跨数据集的泛化能力以及对代表性不足事件的敏感性。我们提出了RECOVAR，这是一种无监督的地震事件检测方法，可直接从原始波形进行训练，无需使用事件/噪声标签。该方法采用卷积自编码器集成，并通过基于互协方差的度量来衡量其压缩潜在表示中的时间对齐性，从而检测事件。结果表明，RECOVAR在公开基准数据集上可达到监督检测器的性能水平，在跨数据集场景下保持稳健，并且在类别不平衡的连续波形数据上依然有效。
tldr: 提出了RECOVAR，一种无需事件/噪声标签、直接从原始波形训练的无监督地震事件检测方法，通过卷积自编码器集成与互协方差度量实现事件检测，性能可比监督检测器并在跨数据集和不平衡数据场景下保持稳健。
en_tdlr: RECOVAR is an unsupervised seismic event detection method trained directly from raw waveforms without event/noise labels, using an ensemble of convolutional autoencoders and a cross-covariance metric to achieve supervised-level performance while remaining robust in cross-dataset and imbalanced scenarios.
